Treasure Found in Jaipur Haveli Excavation

A treasure of gold coins and silver bars was discovered during the excavation of an old haveli in Jaipur. The excavation, which began with the foundation work, yielded 15 clay pots filled with gold coins weighing around 45 kg and over 10,000 silver coins. The owner has filed a case against the workers who allegedly divided the treasure among themselves.
